company_name: SHENZHEN CSL VACUUM SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical components for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in wafer front-end processes.
summary: Shenzhen CSL Vacuum Science and Technology Co., Ltd specializes in the development, production, and sales of plasma RF power supply systems and related accessories for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are integral to processes such as thin film deposition and plasma etching, serving major equipment manufacturers and wafer fabrication facilities.
capabilities: Vacuum acquisition and fluid control solutions

regional_presence.China: The company is recognized as a leading domestic supplier, delivering products to major equipment manufacturers and wafer fabrication facilities in China.
